_note: Role pose for scripts/bone_roles.py compile. rotate is degrees about the character's own axes: X to its right, Y forward, Z up; right-hand rule, X then Y then Z. +X swings a hanging limb forward and tips a rising part back; +Z brings the right shoulder forward. A right-handed swing, not an overhead strike: the arm is drawn back and out on the wind up, then swung forward and across the body.
_frame: anticipation: weight back, striking arm drawn
wind up: arm drawn back and out, torso turned away, front knee lifted
strike: arm swung forward and across, torso leans and turns into it, lunge
follow through: settling back from the strike
